QuestInfo.name: [Luna Crystal] Pretty Pony Carousel
QuestInfo.0: Wisp wants to talk to you while you're on a walk with the Lil Pony Pets. What can this be about?
QuestInfo.1:
Equip all 3 Lil Pony Pets, then return to Wisp.
You must equip the #rPetite Luna Pets born from the Luna Crystal#k before you go.

#b#e[Lil Pony Set]#k#n\r\n#i5002079# #t5002079#  #i5002080#  #t5002080#\r\n#i5002081#  #t5002081#
QuestInfo.2: You brought all of the Lil Ponies and got a gift from Wisp.

0.0: Hello, traveler! It's been a while. As usual, you have such a... pure aura surrounding you... \r\n
0.1: Oh my! The... The source... The source of your pure aura is...\r\n
0.2: Could it really be...? One of the ponies spoke of in legend? My heart is racing! I never imagined such a beautiful, magical creature could be real...\r\nThanks to you, #b#h0##k... I was able to meet a being I'd only dreamt of.\r\n
0.3:
Listen to me, #b#h0##k. If you bring me the full #e#bLil Pony Set#k#n to view and admire, I'll give you a beautiful gift! It's something I've saved for that very day. What do you think?

#r(You can only participate in this event once per world.)#k

no.0: The three Lil Pony Pets... I really want to see all of them... Would you rethink your decision? If you change your mind, talk to me again!

1.0: To be able to meet all the Lil Pony Pets in one place... This is the best day ever! And it's all thanks to you, #b#h0##k. I'm so full of joy that I'll simply burst if I don't share some of it with you.
1.1: Hehehe, this is a special music box I made long ago and saved for this very day! It's yours now.

yes.0:
You now possess your very own Pretty Pony Carousel! It's #ba special chair you can sit on with your Petite Luna pets#k. Furthermore, #byou can give commands and delicious treats to Petite Luna pets while sitting#k!

You can also sit on it with Fairy pets, not just Pony pets.

Anyway, I hope you and your lovely pets share everlasting happiness!
